action.command: curl -sL --max-time 30 https://api.github.com/repos/ddollar/forego/releases | grep -oE '"tag_name": *"[^"]*"' | head; echo "==="; curl -sL --max-time 30 https://api.github.com/repos/ddollar/forego/releases | grep -oE 'browser_download_url": *"[^"]*"' | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -sL --max-time 30 https://api.github.com/repos/ddollar/forego/releases | grep -oE '\"tag_name\": *\"[^\"]*\"' | head; echo \"===\"; curl -sL --max-time 30 https://api.github.com/repos/ddollar/forego/releases | grep -oE 'browser_download_url\": *\"[^\"]*\"' | head -20", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "List all forego releases"}
